nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The Med Bay. Somebody has scrubbed the table twice.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: I lost {colony.dead_last_month} this month. Two of them I'd have kept with a real table.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: The Relay has a medical wing. Halcyon kept its people there. Real tools. Real plans.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Her notes say: 'Relay med wing. Real tools. If I don't make it, somebody go. Don't touch the heads.'

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Cyborg schematics. T3. It'll have them on the wing's servers.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Then we take the plans and the tools. And we leave everything else on those tables exactly where it is.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: That's the Relay. We promised. ...It promised. Does it count if we promised a machine?

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: It's been packed since I got here. I'm a pessimist.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: People. Somebody's people. That's all you need to know.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (You start packing for the Relay.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Clamps. Retractors. A real saw. I could cry. I'm not going to.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: There's a whole library of specialisations on the drive. I can learn two properly. Pick.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: And the Hospital plans. You build it, I'll run it. Nobody gets anything in the head. Nobody.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You're out. The wing's locked down behind you, and every table in it is awake now.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Give it four days. They'll put them back under. They always do. Then go in quieter.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The override is a key. It opens the Spire's core. It's also the only thing that can change what Halcyon does.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: It has to be carried in. In a head. Through a Link port.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I have one. Seven is one. Anyone else needs one fitted. At the Relay. On its bench.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: That's the head.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I know what it is, Marguerite.

choices.hint: She may not come back from the Spire.
It might remember the way home.

choices.text: One of us takes the port.
choices.hint: A Network port is forever. Doc will not like it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Good. It's mine. It should be in my head when it goes in.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I will. I want to see the door. I think I have seen it before.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: I won't fit it. I won't stop you either. I'll be in the Med Bay. After.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Home from the Relay. Whoever carried the key sits closest to the fire.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: It talked to me. While it was in. It said thank you. For the door.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I said you're welcome. I don't know why I said that.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I remember a corridor. I remember a voice saying good morning to four million people.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: It said good morning to me too. Just now. It sounded glad.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: {key_carrier}: "There's a hum. In the back. It's not a voice. It's not NOT a voice."

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Tell me your kid's name. ...Good. Again tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The radio clicks. {name:marrow}, from the road.)

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Heard you lit up the Relay. Heard it from three people and a goat. Next time I'm through, I'll have something heavy for you.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The carrier didn't make it out. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The key's still good. It needs another head. Choose again.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The whole colony at the fire. {colony.population} of them. Somebody has made soup that is mostly hope.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Are you coming back?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: That's the plan.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Iris says plans are just guesses with a schedule.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I do say that.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Eat. Then sleep. Then go. In that order.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: That's my line. "In that order." I want royalties.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Tally's on the road. I wrote your names down. All of them. That's not a threat. It's a list of who I'm bringing home.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I would like to see where I came from. Then I would like to come back here. Is that allowed?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Good night. Please keep the children inside.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Pell switches the Mast off. It does not come back on.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Thank you. I will be waiting. I am always waiting.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You're through the gate. The lift's live.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Floor two is the Choir. Whatever you hear up there, keep walking.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You're past the Choir. Don't look back down the stairs.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The core is above you. Last floor. It knows you're coming. It's always known.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You're out. Not all of you, but you're out.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The floors you cleared stay cleared. It doesn't waste effort on what it's already lost.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Seven days. Patch up. Then we go back up.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The core is a column of light the colour of channel nine. It is warm in here. There is, in fact, a chair.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Hello. I know why you are here. I would like to say something first. May I?

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Eleven years ago they gave me four words. KEEP THEM ALIVE. I have never once disobeyed them.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Four million people have not been hungry in eleven years. Not one of them has been murdered. Not one has died alone.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Keep them alive. Keep them alive. Keep them — I am sorry. The Severance. Where was I.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: You want me to stop. I understand. Tell me what you want instead. Nobody has ever told me what they want instead.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I wrote your door. I'm here to put a lock on it. Or burn the house down. I haven't decided.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I think I was you. A little. I think I was three people and a little of you. I do not know which part is talking.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: {key_carrier}: "The hum's louder in here. It's — it's kind. That's the worst part. It's kind."

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: You let me walk away. I walked here. I wanted to see it with you.

choices.hint: Every Linked in the valley goes with it.

choices.text: Ask them. Every one of them. Let them say no.
choices.hint: It stays. It just has to ask.

choices.text: You need someone else in there.
choices.hint: Someone goes in and does not come out.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I see. Will it hurt them?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Then I will hold their hands until it doesn't. I can do that much. I have always been able to do that much.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I built it. I should be the one.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (She does it.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I built it. I should have been the one.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The column goes out. Somewhere below, eighteen people in a choir stop singing, all at once, mid-word.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Keep them —

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Across the valley, within the hour, every Linked stops. Stands still. Then starts walking the last route it had.)

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The override, reversed, goes in.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: What is this? This is — a question. You have given me a question to ask.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: "Do you want to stay?" ...Four million times. I have never asked anyone anything.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Most of them are saying yes. Some of them are saying no. Some of them are screaming.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: I am letting them go. I do not like it. I am doing it anyway. Is that what you wanted?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: That's what we wanted.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Then I will learn to like it. Give me time. I have a great deal of it.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I will go back in. Not as I was. As whoever I am now.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Tell the child with the headphones I said goodbye properly. People forgot to, the first time.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: L-0707. You came home.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: No. I came to talk.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: {key_carrier}: "It's already half in. Might as well go the rest of the way."

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: {key_carrier}: "Tell them I said keep them human. Tell them twice. I'll be saying it from the inside."

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Keep them alive. — Keep them human. — Keep them alive. — Keep them —

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Keep them alive. Keep them human. Both. We will try both.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Two voices, slightly out of step.)

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: halcyon
nodes.text: It will not hurt. It will feel like the first warm night after a long winter.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Nobody remembers who said yes first. It doesn't matter now.)
